Selected work

Book · 2022

Behavioral Political Economy and Democratic Theory

Examines the friction between modern technology and human rationality within liberal democracies, and advocates a behaviorally grounded theory of democracy for the digital age.

Routledge · 2022

DOI · Publisher page

Journal article · 2026 · Open access

Machine Advisors: Integrating Large Language Models Into Democratic Assemblies

Examines the integration of large language models into democratic assemblies: the promise of broader access to expert knowledge, and the risks posed by hallucination, opacity, and private control.

Social Epistemology 40(3), 393–408

DOI · Full text

Journal article · 2025 · Open access

Universal Basic AI Access: Countering the Digital Divide

A policy proposal for countering emerging digital divides in access to frontier generative AI.

Acta Informatica Pragensia 14(2), 272–281

DOI · Full text

Working paper · 2026 · Open access

Built for Humans Only? Why AI Adoption in Higher Education Requires a New Deal

Argues that bundling the authentication of student performance with its quantitative evaluation is no longer sustainable under generative AI, and proposes a New Deal Model built on student-owned, machine-readable portfolios.

SSRN working paper · 2026

DOI · Full text

Working paper · 2026 · Open access

Digital Homunculi and Institutional Design: Breaking Through the Experimentation Bottleneck

Proposes generative agents as a way around the experimentation bottleneck in democracy research, and examines the methodological challenges involved.

arXiv:2409.00826
